name: Alderney
description: The red St George's Cross on a white field, with the arms of Alderney at the centre: a gold lion holding a green sprig of three leaves, on a green disc within a gold border.
history: Alderney, the northernmost of the Channel Islands and part of the Bailiwick of Guernsey, long flew the plain St George's Cross — the pattern shared with Guernsey's other dependencies. The island's arms, a gold lion grasping a sprig, were granted on 20 December 1993 and were added at the centre of the cross to give the present flag. GBA is Alderney's international vehicle registration code and the alpha-3 code element indeterminately reserved for it under the UN road-traffic conventions.

features.symbolism: Alderney's tie to Guernsey and its dependencies
